$comment: Machine-readable parameter descriptors for every module type. Generated by `cargo run -p pertylizer --bin gen_schemas` — do not edit by hand. Keys match the `type` discriminator and parameter keys in saved `.pertyproj` files. Numeric params carry {min, max, default, unit, response_curve}; automation-lane values are normalized 0..1 through `response_curve` over [min, max] (see synth_core ResponseCurve::normalize / denormalize).
